annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/817 of 6 March 2024 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 as regards harmonised standards for sterilisation of health care products and packaging for terminally sterilised medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/817 of 6 March 2024 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 as regards harmonised standards for sterilisation of health care products and packaging for terminally sterilised medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision adding amended harmonised standards on radiation sterilisation (EN ISO 11137-2) and sterile packaging (EN ISO 11607-1/-2) to the list supporting Regulation (EU) 2017/746 on in vitro diagnostic medical devices, conferring presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Annex to Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 by adding entries 11-13.
Compliance with the listed standards gives presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/746.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
